doc: I35's OWN sidecar (fixed at the prereg): the Go document rule OWN reads, Go 1.24's slice growth (the constants of runtime/sizeclasses.go, runtime/slice.go and runtime/msize.go of the pinned go1.24.7 toolchain, config replay.go_version), and the bounded search of holon.own_run.

growth.doc: growslice for a byte slice (no pointers, no malloc header): newcap = nextslicecap(newLen, oldCap) (newLen when newLen > 2*oldCap; 2*oldCap when oldCap < threshold; else oldCap grown by (newcap + 3*threshold) >> 2 until >= newLen), then roundupsize: the smallest class_to_size entry >= newcap, or above the last class the next multiple of page. Appending k bytes to (len, cap) is in place iff len + k <= cap. Assumption A-go-growth; each replay checks every capacity.

search.byte_values: argument i (0-based, in trace order) is the byte string of its length whose every byte is (i + 1) mod 256
search.doc: holon.own_run's bounded search for an alias witness: a prefix of calls of the type's modelled methods from the constructor's value, then V, then W with arguments from the pool; the first trace whose model check fails is the witness.
search.order: traces by length, then by the methods' sorted order, then by byte_lengths' order
